description: Change an X lead form. Only the fields you pass change — but X replaces the fields list and each section (intro, thank-you page, privacy policy) WHOLE, so pass the complete new value of any you touch. An archived form cannot be changed. Read back from X. Free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

companyName.description: company name shown on the form

conversionEventId.description: X Events Manager event id; needed when the account has no X Pixel

fields.description: replaces the whole field list; each entry as in create_x_ads_lead_form

key.description: lead field the form collects, from X's fixed list of lead field keys

optional.description: true = the person may skip this field; at least one field must not be optional

name.description: new internal name of the lead form

privacyPolicyUrl.description: https link to the privacy policy shown on the form

purpose.description: what the leads are used for, shown to the person

thankYouDescription.description: thank-you page text; X replaces the whole section

thankYouHeadline.description: thank-you page headline; X replaces the whole section

thankYouUrl.description: https link on the thank-you button

name: update_x_ads_lead_form
title: Change an X lead form
